text: 会议指出，要进一步发挥服务业对经济发展的支撑作用，加力推进服务业扩能提质，把服务业潜力空间转化为发展动能。要加快破解服务业发展的难点堵点，聚焦生产生活重点领域因业施策，加强融资、用地、人才、数据等支持，稳步推进公共事业领域价格改革，加大力度盘活用好闲置资源。
text_en: The meeting noted that it is necessary to further leverage the supporting role of the service sector in economic development, step up efforts to expand and improve the service sector, and transform the service sector's potential into development momentum. It is necessary to accelerate the resolution of difficulties and bottlenecks in service sector development, adopt targeted policies for key production and living areas, strengthen support in financing, land use, talent, data and other areas, steadily advance price reforms in public utilities, and intensify efforts to revitalize and make good use of idle resources.
